paite: "Ka naupan chik a pan in mi'n tamveipi ahon mangbangsak ua." Israelte'n chi uhen.
heading: Israelte Melmate Dou Dia Thumna

paite: "Ka naupan chik a pan in mi'n tamveipi hon mangbangsak ua; himahleh hon zou tuan kei uh.
Lei lette'n ka nungzang ah lei alet ua; aleileh kuangte uh asausak uhi."
TOUPA adiktat ahi; migilou-saloute khauhualte a- attanta, chi in.
Amau zahlak leh taizaksak in om uhen, Zion hote tengteng mah.
Inn tung a loupa akhansang ma a vuai bang in om uhen.
Huai loupa in buh atmi khut ahihdim nhei kei a, bumphali telkhawmimin leng a-angsung ahihdim ngei sam kei hi.
Na tung uah TOUPA vualzawlna om hen; TOUPA min in ka hon vualzawl uhi, apaikhen mite'n achi sam kei uhi.
